name: Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Soft Tissue Tumors

criteria.description: Presence of pleomorphic spindle cells with marked nuclear atypia and high mitotic activity on histopathological examination
Lack of specific lineage differentiation markers; vimentin positive, negative for markers of other sarcoma subtypes
Imaging showing a deep soft tissue mass with heterogeneous enhancement and areas of necrosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of pleomorphic spindle cells with exclusion of other sarcoma subtypes by immunohistochemistry
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other sarcomas and carcinomas; molecular testing may assist in differential diagnosis.

searchTerms: malignant tumor in muscles or fat

laboratory: Elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) in some cases
Anemia of chronic disease in advanced stages
imaging: MRI showing heterogeneous soft tissue mass with necrosis
CT scan for assessment of local invasion and metastasis
PET scan for staging and detection of distant metastases
genetic: No specific recurrent genetic mutation; complex karyotype common
Molecular testing to exclude other sarcoma subtypes
other: Histopathology revealing pleomorphic spindle cells with high mitotic index

distinguishingFeatures: Positive smooth muscle actin and desmin immunohistochemistry
MDM2 gene amplification on molecular testing

redFlags: Rapid tumor growth over weeks to months
New onset neurological deficits due to nerve compression
Unexplained weight loss and systemic symptoms
references: WHO Classification of Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours, 5th Edition, 2020
Fletcher CDM, Bridge JA, Hogendoorn PCW, Mertens F. WHO Classification of Tumours of Soft Tissue and Bone. IARC; 2013.
